resources.string: Hide and seek a 3-digit secret number with unique digits. Each guess is scored as R (right place) and W (wrong place). Crack the pattern before your friends do.
Tap Auto to generate and hide a number.
Friend mode: enter a number, then tap Hide.
Game on. Enter a guess and tap Check.
Round over. Tap Reset to play again.
The secret must be exactly 3 unique digits.
Your guess must be exactly 3 unique digits.
Great job. You cracked the secret number.
Revealing the number ends this round. You can start a fresh game with Reset.
This will clear all guesses and start over.
Switching mode will reset the current round.
Quick, fair, and fun for one or two players.

1) The secret number always has exactly 3 unique digits.

2) The seeker also enters a 3-digit guess with unique digits.

3) R means a guessed digit exists and is in the correct position.

4) W means a guessed digit exists but is in a different position.

5) If no guessed digit exists in the secret, the remark is SMYLE (Simply Make Your Life Easy).

6) 3R means Winner.

Example:
Secret = 245
Guess = 325 -> 1R, 1W
(5 is right position, 2 exists but wrong position)

Try to use each remark to eliminate impossible combinations and solve faster.

Guesser is a logic puzzle game inspired by classic number deduction challenges. It started as a personal Android project and has now been modernized with updated libraries, cleaner architecture, and a refreshed design.
Play solo with auto-generated secrets or pass the phone to a friend in versus mode. Every round trains pattern recognition, memory, and reasoning while keeping gameplay quick and playful.
Tune how the game responds to each guess.
